typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Member_Number as string,
		Phone_Number as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT	DISTINCT convert(varchar(30),MC.Subscriber_ID + \'00\')  AS \'Member_Number\', 		substring(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(CV.STR_VALUE,\'-\',\'\'),\')\',\'\'),\'(\',\'\'),\' \',\'\'),\'.\',\'\'),0,11) AS \'Phone_Number\' FROM	P_MEMBER_HRA PMH WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN	P_MEMBER_CONCEPT_VALUE CV WITH (NOLOCK) 		ON PMH.CID = CV.CID JOIN	MEMBER M WITH (NOLOCK)  		ON  PMH.CID = M.CID JOIN	MEMBER_COVERAGE MC WITH (NOLOCK)  		ON M.CID = MC.CID WHERE	PMH.HRA_ID = 2007								  AND	PMH.STATUS = 2		   AND	CV.CONCEPT_ID = 542495							  AND	PMH.SYSTEM_DATE > ?								parameter',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CareAdvancePhoneNumbers
CareAdvancePhoneNumbers derive(xMemberNumber = substring(toString(Member_Number), toInteger(1), toInteger(30)),
		Phone_Number = substring(toString(Phone_Number), toInteger(1), toInteger(10))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(xPhone_Number = toString(Phone_Number)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(xPhone_Number = xPhone_Number) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		Phone_Number as string,
		Member_Number as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Phone_Number = xPhone_Number,
		Member_Number = xMemberNumber)) ~> PDSCAREADVANCEPHONESTAGING
